title: Wara Wara no Mi
structure: 3 techniques + the giant straw man as the peak (the fruit has no stages and no awakening)
facts: Appearance: not revealed (plain swirl fruit stands in)
Paramecia, Straw-Straw Fruit: create and control straw, grown from the body
Straw weapons and armour; Straw Man: a towering scarecrow effigy the user fights from (Goma no Sō)
Straw dolls linked to up to ten people take the damage done to the user; once used up, the damage hits the user
Basil Hawkins of the Worst Generation; Killer beat him by cutting the doll arm linked to Kid's missing left arm (Wano)

plan.labels: WEAPONS, DOLLS, TEN LINKS, STRAW MAN
plan.fruit: The fruit's appearance **has never been revealed**, so a plain round swirl fruit in straw gold stands in (no face or limbs).
cast: **Enemy (new, original):** a boxer in red trunks and a red tank top.
**Basil Hawkins:** long pale-blond hair, cream long coat over a dark-purple shirt. Send a reference to match him exactly.
**Killer:** round blue-and-white striped mask, long blond hair, black polka-dot shirt, jeans.
plan.sets: red barn, gold rays, wheat field, haystack farm, tarot-card stage, harvest fair, boxing gym, voodoo doll shop, field at dusk, candle-lit tarot room, corn maze, Wano rooftop under the moon, hay loft.
